resources.string: One tap on the orb and your assistant is listening.
Tell us what happened, or what you would like improved. Mention the screen you were on, or add a screenshot of it from Gallery.

Lets your assistant do tasks you ask for inside other apps — open a chat, type a message, add to a cart — by reading the screen and tapping for you. It only acts while a task you asked for is running, shows a Stop button the whole time, and asks you before anything that sends, pays, orders or deletes. It never reads or types passwords or codes.
